# Sketch the release notes layout

## Question

What should one release's notes look like on the page?

## Answer

Undermined by [Audit the quality of merged PR titles](./04-audit-pr-titles.md): the sketch assumes every title starts with a conventional-commit prefix, and most do not.

The [sketch](../assets/layout-sketch.md) groups entries under Features, Fixes and Chores, each with a one-line summary.
The group names still hold, but how an entry lands in a group is open again.
